title: PreorderAlternativesRequiredV1
description: Outbox event (spec 11 §5.3, Inv-10) emitted when live revalidation finds a stale pre-order line (item unpublished / price changed) or no capacity at hold time — nothing was acquired, so the saga ends FailedFinal and the customer must re-confirm against current alternatives (spec-06 AlternativesRequired). Carries opaque ids + coarse stale-line reasons only (Inv-12).

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the saga chain.

reason.description: Coarse reason when not line-specific, e.g. 'no_capacity'.

stale_lines.description: Per-line stale reasons when revalidation failed.
